job_spec.purpose: mtp-fixlat-1011 2026-10-10 (ds-1010 latency audit eff5a6f0a: links AT RISK of the fixed-latency grant bug fixed on seq<->WFC). collective-slab end of the P2 links: lane-1 + start transmitters (ltx), result-row receiver lrx_rtt sized p2->coll 9 / coll->p2 8 (D21). Gates: tools/mtp_fixlat_gate.py stationed benches (relay stations at the generator counts) + latency-1 / stale / as-is negatives; option B TT>=0 FF>=0 DRC0. Cycles: 0 at full rate for the seq ends; P2 link ends +9 cycles per P2 transaction (measured, tb_mtp_p2_fixlat NOSTALL lnk 6,122 vs direct core 6,113 at 0 stations). REV 5b059065b: fixlat-collp2-ffbec0c86-tc NEEDS_RTL TT -64.76 = c_or (collective core ready) -> 594-b c_data / wp enables (13 levels); now every core-facing port is a single flop (ltx_rc) and the result row reaches the collective core on the grant protocol (c_or = grant), no core input fans into the row registers. REV 5b059065b: lane-1 path removed (dsfd_coll_p2_lane_ba OGRANT sends lane 1; no tied-off ports); core-side result row valid/ready via an abutting ltx_rc -> lrx D4 SEL1 pair (dsfd_coll_p2_lane_pa interface). Gates: tools/mtp_fixlat_gate.py P2 cases + tools/mtp_p2lane_gate.py (collective slab in context). REV fe3fdec4c (idle-sweep-1011): fixlat-collp2-5b059065b-tc NEEDS_RTL TT -52.31 at the routed insertion (FF +5.08, DRC 0, reg2reg +89) = output class u_oc.rp -> D4 read mux (OA22/AND3/AOI21) -> c_od[*] under the 0.62 T output budget; fix: ot_sc_pfifo S2 output register after u_oc (c_od = one AND-OR of flop copies, c_ov/c_or-side flops). +1 cycle per result row. REDROP 966562e4c: fe3fdec4c RTL unchanged; calibrate failed in synth because SRCS lacked rtl/common/ot_sc_pfifo.sv (added). | REDROP el1011-ds-wfc 2026-10-11: 966562e4c route crashed in yosys (Re-definition of ot_sc_pfifo): the route stage SRCS listed rtl/common/ot_sc_pfifo.sv twice (calibrate once) -> deduped. RTL = fe3fdec4c structural fix (pfifo S2 core-facing output register; c_od one AND-OR of flop copies; c_or -> pointer state only), never routed before. Variant a: HM 0.010, PD 0.30.
